concerns.text: FR-008 mandates a sensitivity analysis sweeping variance thresholds including '[deferred]'. The spec must resolve this placeholder to a concrete set of values (e.g., 90%, 95%, 99%) or remove the requirement. A spec cannot mandate a sweep over an undefined value; this violates the 'converged spec' requirement to have no surviving [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] or [deferred] markers in requirement definitions.

The acceptance scenario requires the system to report statistical power and flag 'inconclusive' results, but the spec does not define the specific power calculation method (e.g., effect size assumption, alpha level) required to generate this report, creating ambiguity in the 'Independent Test' definition.
